In the REST module (`openmrs-module-webservices.rest`), four methods in three resource classes call `ProgramWorkflowService.savePatientProgram`. A behaviour change would affect all of them. I searched only that repository for `savePatientProgram`, so I haven't checked for indirect callers or for callers in other modules.

1. `ProgramEnrollmentResource1_8.save` (line 93) returns the result of `savePatientProgram` directly. It backs create and update of program enrolments, so it is the most exposed to a change in the return value or save behaviour.
2. `PatientStateResource1_8.save` (line 115) adds the new state to the parent `PatientProgram`'s states and then saves the program.
3. `PatientStateResource1_8.delete` (line 78) voids the last patient state and then saves the program.
4. `PatientProgramAttributeResource2_2.save` (line 86) adds the attribute to the program if it isn't already active, then saves the program.
5. `PatientProgramAttributeResource2_2.delete` (line 65) marks the attribute voided and then saves the program.
